summary: The root QRF relates to mixing with others, especially those who are diseased. It signifies being near to someone or a place infected with illness, particularly pestilence or epidemic disease.
lane: قَرَفٌ ذ The mixing with others; [and particularly with others who are diseased or the like ]; a subst. from : (K:) the being near to [ a person, or persons, or a place, infected with ] disease: (S, TA:) the being near to pestilence, or epidemic disease. (T in art. تلف .) See تَلَفٌ .
